summary: Iteration 5: Verified all 10 requested improvements. Backend: 18/18 new tests pass (content manifest + 4 content docs + feedback + newsletter + admin config read/save/list for content/*.md). Frontend: browser tab title 'Hariram\'s Pure Cow Ghee' + favicon /assets/logo/logo.webp confirmed after frontend restart; nav shows WHY HARIRAM'S (Our Story removed); /why-hariram /recipes /faq /contact all render correct H1 + placeholder; footer has Feedback link, My Account is a single link to /account; footer newsletter SUBSCRIBE button width=91px height=34px fontSize=11px - NO overflow at 1920px viewport; Feedback form submits successfully (data-testid=feedback-form) and toast/thank-you visible; Cart drawer 'Continue Shopping' (data-testid=cart-continue-shopping) - from '/' scrolls #products into view, from /faq navigates to /#products (both cases work); Mongo persistence confirmed for feedback (5 docs) and newsletter (10 docs, upsert idempotent).

ui_bugs.issue: React hydration/DOM warning: <span> cannot be a child of <option> (line 103 in feedback rating select). Emergent visual-edit-overlay wraps each option's expression in a <span data-ve-dynamic='true'>, which is invalid HTML inside <select><option>. Does NOT break functionality (form submits successfully) but produces console errors on every render.

action_items: Note: /app/frontend/public/index.html changes only take effect after frontend process restart (CRA loads template at boot). After my `sudo supervisorctl restart frontend` the served HTML now has correct <title>Hariram's Pure Cow Ghee</title> and <link rel='icon' href='/assets/logo/logo.webp'>. Main agent may want to add a note or CI step.
Optional: In FeedbackPage.jsx rating <select>, either wrap option text in {String(n)} or use plain literal to avoid the visual-edit-overlay <span> injection inside <option> (React warning).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py /api/content/{doc_id}: id sanitization strips non-[a-z0-9_] chars - safe. Good use of manifest lookup for title.

Feedback endpoint stores UTC ISO timestamps and uuid4 id - clean. No PII/rate-limiting on /api/feedback or /api/newsletter/subscribe - if promo mailer collects publicly, consider CAPTCHA or per-IP rate limit before go-live.
Newsletter uses upsert on lowercased email - correct idempotency.
admin_config.py continues to safely handle content/ folder via _resolve() path traversal guard (verified via regression).

ScrollToTop component: consider excluding hash-only navigation (window.scrollTo(0,0) can conflict with anchor #products). Currently works because CartDrawer explicitly uses navigate('/#products') then scrolls after route change - fine.
Frontend index.html changes require frontend restart to propagate - not a bug but a deployment note.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Content pages are markdown files under /app/backend/config/content/ + content_manifest.json listing them. Backend endpoints: GET /api/content/manifest, GET /api/content/{doc_id}. Feedback: POST /api/feedback → Mongo `feedback`. Newsletter: POST /api/newsletter/subscribe → Mongo `newsletter` (upsert). Frontend routes: /why-hariram /recipes /faq /contact all use ContentPage.jsx with useParams. Testids present: feedback-page, feedback-form, feedback-rating, cart-continue-shopping. Frontend index.html requires supervisorctl restart frontend to reflect edits (CRA snapshot at boot).
rca of the issue: Only cosmetic FeedbackPage rating <span> in <option> warning. Root cause: visual-edit-overlay wraps every JSX expression (n at line 103) in <span data-ve-dynamic>. Placement inside <select><option> triggers React hydration warning. Not a functional bug.
